LanguageData.ST_CustomNote: custom – the game keeps its own values
LanguageData.ST_FromGame: Take values from the current game
LanguageData.ST_HelpDifficulty: Pick the difficulty you want to edit (modded ones too). Changes are saved and apply to new games and to a running game that uses this difficulty. "Current game" edits only the running game's values (saved with it).
LanguageData.ST_HelpStoryteller: Pick the storyteller you want to edit. Changes apply at once, also in a running game.
LanguageData.ST_NoteDifficulty: Yellow mark = changed. Hover to see the original value. Write ranges as 1~3.
LanguageData.ST_NoteStoryteller: Yellow mark = changed. Hover to see the original value. Write ranges as 1~3. Values belong to the storyteller's parts (#1, #2…).
LanguageData.ST_NoteCurrent: You are editing the running game's values – they are saved with the game, not in the mod settings.
LanguageData.ST_T_pop: How much the storyteller sends people (refugees, joiners …) while the colony is small. 1 = original, 0.5 = half, 2 = double.
LanguageData.ST_T_onDays: How long the dangerous part of the cycle lasts.
LanguageData.ST_T_offDays: How long the calm part of the cycle lasts.
LanguageData.ST_T_minSpacingDays: The fewest days between two events of this part.
LanguageData.ST_T_mtbDays: Average time between events. Lower = more often.
LanguageData.ST_T_weight: How often the random pick chooses this event category. Higher = more often.
